s: We have built a scalable, highly available platform ready for future expansion into big data frameworks that power data science, machine learning, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). Our platform’s uptime in the last year exceeded 99.9% while we delivered hundreds of product improvements through dozens of software releases in a continuous software delivery cycle.
The deployment of data analytics and artificial intelligence is expected to further accelerate in the coming years, bolstering the fintech market growth.

These strategies are complemented by investments in research and development activities aimed at integrating advanced technologies such as machine learning and blockchain into digital lending platforms.
